summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **What I audited first (read-only, no code changes made):** the full chain — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → Vite proxy → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` auth middleware → `getUserId()` → Drizzle queries scoped by `user_id` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables → session table (`db/auth.ts`) → cookie issuance in `modules/auth/handlers.ts` → CORS config in `server.ts`.  **Finding so far:** every link in that chain looks correctly wired on inspection — no localStorage/anonymous fallback in `WatchlistPage.
